none: PAS FindID 995813: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18, lightly struck on a thin reddish flan, though bust suggests a regular issue. Obverse description: Bust pearl diademed right, large eye. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 1.15gms, die axis: 6
